author: Mark Manson
description:
Feelings don’t just influence behavior—they drive it. What we do is usually decided by what we’re willing to feel in the moment, not what we logically agree with later.


Watch the full episode to find out which one is keeping you stuck: https://open.spotify.com/episode/6vgdtETFrsxnazLmJaobAE?si=k3i3ll9JQlmxHnmbexBWlA
